## Further listening

Nissim Lebovits of [Radiant Earth](https://radiant.earth/) and Elizabeth Wesley of the [World Resources Institute](https://www.wri.org/) discuss the dataset on [Great Data Products](https://greatdataproducts.com/). In the episode [Fit for Purpose: Building Global Heat Data for Local Planning](https://greatdataproducts.com/episodes/2026/09/wesley-heat-data/), they explain why a five-year P95 composite serves cities with no other heat data. The episode also covers the decision to leave emissivity gaps unfilled.
